how_to_apply: Visit the official NLC India Limited website at www.nlcindia.in.
Open the Careers or Recruitment section.
Find Advertisement No. 10/2026 - Graduate Executive Trainee through GATE 2025.
Read the detailed notification and confirm eligibility for the selected engineering discipline.
Open the online application facility when registration begins.
Register using the GATE 2025 Registration Number, Name, Email ID and Mobile Number.
Complete the required account registration and login process.
Select one recruitment area: Area-1, Area-2, Area-3 or Area-4.
Enter the required personal, educational, age and category details.
Upload the prescribed photograph and signature.
Upload qualification certificates, marksheets, GATE scorecard and other supporting documents.
Use the View Document option to verify the uploaded files.
Complete the online application fee payment through the prescribed SBI E-Collect facility.
Review all information before final submission.
Submit the completed application within the notified deadline.
Download and print the registration-cum-application form.
Keep the application printout and original documents ready for verification.

Important: Candidates must choose only one area. If applications are submitted for multiple areas, NLCIL will consider only the latest application and its selected area. Applicants cannot claim selection against vacancies in another area.
important_instructions: NLC India has announced 143 Graduate Executive Trainee vacancies. Recruitment is based on GATE 2025 scores. Only Mechanical, Electrical, Civil and Mining disciplines are notified. Online registration opens on 13 November 2026. The last date for registration is 14 December 2026. The fee payment deadline is 14 December 2026 at 11:45 PM. Eligible registered and paid candidates can complete final submission by 16 December 2026. Qualifications and reservation eligibility are assessed as on 1 November 2026. Minimum aggregate marks are 60% for UR/EWS/OBC-NCL and 50% for SC/ST, subject to the applicable vacancy conditions. The applicant must choose one recruitment area. GATE 2025 contributes 80 marks and the Personal Interview contributes 20 marks. Shortlisting is separate for each area. Training lasts one year in E-2 Grade. Successful trainees are absorbed into E-3 Grade as notified. A Rs. 3 lakh service bond applies for three years of service after training. Transfer requests are restricted during the first three years from joining. Application fees are non-refundable. Original documents and medical fitness are mandatory. NLCIL may increase, decrease or cancel vacancies according to its requirements.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Vacancy 2026 - 143 Posts
content_sections.text: NLC India Limited has announced 143 Graduate Executive Trainee vacancies across four engineering disciplines. Mechanical Engineering has the highest number of vacancies with 66 posts, followed by Electrical Engineering with 44 posts. The vacancies are distributed across four operational areas. Candidates must select the area in which they wish to compete. Important: Mining Engineering vacancies are available only under Area-2. Mechanical Engineering vacancies are available under Areas 1, 2 and 3, while Electrical and Civil Engineering vacancies are available across all four areas according to the notification. The notification also provides horizontal reservation for eligible Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, including certain carried-forward vacancies. PwBD reservations are included in the notified total and must not be added separately.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess a recognized Bachelor's degree in the prescribed engineering branch and must have qualified in the corresponding GATE 2025 paper. Qualifications must have been obtained from Indian universities or institutions recognized by UGC, AICTE or the appropriate statutory authority. Important: Degrees regarded as equivalent, or degrees combining branches other than those specifically notified, will not be accepted merely on the basis of claimed equivalence. The final aggregate percentage is calculated using the marks of all years, semesters or trimesters. Rounding up is not permitted; candidates must meet the exact prescribed percentage. SC/ST candidates applying against unreserved vacancies must satisfy the unreserved qualification standard without claiming the reserved-category marks relaxation. Yes. All applicants must have qualified in GATE 2025 in the paper corresponding to their notified engineering discipline. No. Candidates must have passed the prescribed qualification by 1 November 2026 . Applicants awaiting final results after that date are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Graduate Executive Trainees will be inducted in E-2 Grade with a basic pay of Rs. 50,000 per month during their one-year training period. The approximate annual CTC is Rs. 14.50 lakh . After successfully completing the one-year training programme, GETs will be absorbed into E-3 Grade , with a pay scale of Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,80,000 and an initial basic pay of Rs. 60,000 per month. Other notified benefits include medical treatment for employees and eligible dependants, group insurance, applicable annual performance-related pay and residential accommodation at standard rent, subject to availability and company rules. Salary Clarification: The CTC is an approximate annual compensation figure, not monthly take-home pay. The advertised basic pay should not be presented as the final net salary after deductions.

rows.after_training: 30% of Basic Pay + DA, as Notified

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Service Agreement Bond 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Graduate Executive Trainees must execute a service agreement bond of Rs. 3,00,000 at joining. The three-year service obligation applies after completion of the one-year training period . Candidates should understand this commitment before accepting an appointment.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 854 for UR, EWS and OBC-NCL candidates and Rs. 354 for SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates . Payment Mode: Online through the State Bank of India E-Collect facility as instructed on the NLCIL application portal. Fee Payment Deadline: 14 December 2026 at 11:45 PM. The fees are non-refundable. Applicable banking service charges, if any, are additional.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of GATE 2025 score evaluation carrying 80 marks and a Personal Interview carrying 20 marks , for a total of 100 marks. Eligible candidates will be shortlisted separately for each recruitment area based on their GATE 2025 marks, generally in a ratio of 1:6 or 1:10 against the notified vacancies, as applicable. The merit list for Area-1, Area-2, Area-3 and Area-4 will be prepared independently, ensuring the applicable reservation provisions. The final merit list will be prepared using the total marks obtained out of 100, combining the weighted GATE 2025 score and Personal Interview marks. If candidates obtain equal final scores at the cut-off, the older candidate will be placed higher. If the tie continues, the alphabetical order of the candidate's first name will be considered.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Recruitment 2026 Posting Locations
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be posted at NLCIL units, mines, power stations, renewable energy projects or associated establishments within their selected area, subject to organizational requirements. Posting Restriction: Selected candidates cannot request transfer to another NLCIL plant, unit or office during the initial three years from their date of joining.

content_sections.text: Important: Candidates must choose only one area. If applications are submitted for multiple areas, NLCIL will consider only the latest application and its selected area. Applicants cannot claim selection against vacancies in another area.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NLC India GET Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload self-attested copies of the prescribed documents and produce original certificates during document verification. The photograph must measure 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm , be taken after 1 March 2026 and be a high-quality studio photograph. The signature must be written in dark blue or black ink. Where multiple documents belong to the same upload field, candidates must arrange them chronologically in a single PDF. Uploading another file in that field may overwrite the earlier upload.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Reservation and Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Reservation and age relaxation are governed by Government of India rules. Candidates claiming reservation must upload the appropriate certificates issued by the competent authority. OBC-NCL candidates must produce a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate obtained on or after 1 April 2026 at document verification. EWS candidates must produce a valid Income and Asset Certificate obtained on or after 1 April 2026 . PwBD candidates must possess the applicable disability certificate or UDID card. Suitability depends on the engineering discipline and the identified disability categories listed in Annexure I. The notification identifies no PwBD suitability category for Mining Engineering.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Document Verification and Medical Fitness
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification before the Personal Interview. They must produce original qualification certificates, GATE 2025 scorecard, category certificates and other applicable records. Candidates employed in Government, Central/State PSUs or qualifying organizations must submit the required No Objection Certificate. Finally selected candidates must undergo a pre-employment medical examination and be declared medically fit according to NLCIL standards before appointment.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NLC India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 December 2026. Applications opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NLC India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 143 vacancies: 66 Graduate Executive Trainee (Mechanical), 44 Graduate Executive Trainee (Electrical), 23 Graduate Executive Trainee (Civil), 10 Graduate Executive Trainee (Mining).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NLC India Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UR / EWS / OBC (NCL): INR 854. SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-servicemen: INR 354.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is UR/EWS: 30 years, OBC(NCL): 33 years, SC: 35 years, ST: 35 years (as on 1 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3, PwBD 10.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: INR 50,000 - 1,60,000 for Graduate Executive Trainee (Mechanical), INR 50,000 - 1,60,000 for Graduate Executive Trainee (Electrical), INR 50,000 - 1,60,000 for Graduate Executive Trainee (Civil), INR 50,000 - 1,60,000 for Graduate Executive Trainee (Mining).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor degree in Engineering/Technology in relevant branch and valid GATE 2025 score. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Minimum qualifying percentage of marks in educational qualification is 60% for UR/EWS/OBC (NCL) and 50% for SC/ST. Candidates must have qualified in GATE 2025 examination in relevant GATE code.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates having qualifications with combination of branches other than notified ones. Candidates already removed/terminated/deserted employment from NLCIL.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: GATE 2025 Score (80 Marks). Personal Interview (20 Marks). Shortlisting for personal interview in the ratio 1:6 or 1:10 based on merit order of GATE 2025 score. Final selection based on total marks scored out of 100 (GATE 2025 score 80 marks + Personal Interview 20 marks).
